Figure 9.4: Canceling a running flash job
Note: The FLS module’s environment shall not call the function Fls_Cancel during a
running Fls_MainFunction invocation.
This can be achieved by one of the following scheduling configurations:
• Possibility 1: The job functions of the NVRAM manager and the flash driver are
synchronized (e.g. called sequentially within one task)
• Possibility 2: The task that calls the Fls_MainFunction function can not be
preempted by another task.
